title: Initial application structure
context: Requirements and operational constraints still need review.
decision: Propose a modular monolith for the first validated slice.
alternatives: A single script; separate services if independent scaling is demonstrated.
consequences: Simple deployment and boundaries; shared process and database failure domains.
cost_complexity: One deployable component; verify hosting costs against the budget.
reconsider_when: Measured workload or ownership constraints justify independently deployed services.
